question: Does reduced mover-stage promotion account for AuroraPIC's confirmed lower energetic-threshold traffic in the critical phase/space window?

basis.observed_before_declaration: Two constrained AuroraPIC microstates had native-ensemble interstep-promotion ratios 0.81265 and 0.80066 and demotion ratios 0.84982 and 0.84261. Field-push outputs did not exist in either code when this rule was designed.
basis.new_diagnostic: Counts threshold transitions between the post-collision velocity entering the mover and the pre-collision velocity leaving it, at the surviving post-drift position.
basis.candidate_independence: The two AuroraPIC checkpoints predate the field-push diagnostic and preserve a common macrostate with independently constrained particle positions and position-velocity pairings.
basis.native_independence: All three native field-push outputs are unseen. They restart from the same locked 2620-cycle checkpoint and differ only by predeclared collision RNG seed.
basis.pre_analysis_execution_amendment: The first AuroraPIC solver invocation completed, but the runner stopped before reading scientific outputs because this rule omitted two inherited generic phase-EEDF gate keys. The keys below were restored from the prior replication rule before any field-push value was inspected; no scientific metric, population floor, repeatability limit, decision boundary, input, or horizon changed.

prospective_decision_rule.field_push_promotion_deficit_supported_i: both AuroraPIC/native field-push promotion-rate ratios are at most 0.90
prospective_decision_rule.field_push_promotion_parity_supported_if: both AuroraPIC/native field-push promotion-rate ratios lie in [0.95, 1.05]
prospective_decision_rule.field_push_demotion_enhancement_supporte: both AuroraPIC/native field-push demotion-rate ratios are at least 1.10
prospective_decision_rule.candidate_repeatability_gate: relative range across the two AuroraPIC microstates no greater than 0.08 for field-push promotion and demotion rates
prospective_decision_rule.native_repeatability_gate: relative range across the three native seeds no greater than 0.15 for field-push promotion and demotion rates

algorithm_contract_limit: The locked AuroraPIC microstates use time-centered MCC velocity while native eduPIC uses its leapfrog half-step MCC velocity. Each ledger isolates its configured mover stage, but the before/after velocity staggering is not identical. A supported field-push deficit would require a subsequent matched-half-step AuroraPIC test before attribution to the electric-field interpolation or mover itself.
claim_boundary: This prospective campaign localizes one energetic-threshold discrepancy in one argon CCP across constrained candidate microstates and native collision-seed replicates. It is not experimental validation, a published-observable acceptance result, proof of general PIC correctness, or a matched-staggering comparison.
